description: The Markdown file editor's preview supports Vim scrolling and returning to edit. The conversation /c/{{SLUG}} runs in a directory holding long.md: a heading "Long read" and a hundred paragraphs. To "open F": press "p" (lowercase) with the Control modifier (on whatever has focus); wait for the finder input ".grp-filter" to be visible; fill it with F; wait for the FIRST ".grp-row" to contain F (assert_text_contains on ".grp-row", which checks the first match: the finder lists every file until the query applies, and Enter opens the top row, so waiting for any row with the text is not enough); press Enter in the finder input; the dialog (role "dialog") whose accessible name matches the regular expression /Edit .*F/ is then "the modal" for F, and its ".monaco-editor" should become visible (up to 15s). "The preview" is the modal's region (role "region") named "Markdown preview". "The editor input" is the modal's ".monaco-editor textarea.inputarea"; to focus it, eval its focus(). Key presses go to whatever has focus; do not click anything to focus first unless a step says so. Perform the steps in order. Read the preview's scrollTop with eval. 1. Navigate to /c/{{SLUG}}. 2. Open long.md. 3. Click the modal's ".vim-toggle". 4. The modal's ".monaco-vim-status" should contain "NORMAL". 5. Click the modal's button named "Preview mode". 6. The preview should be focused (document.activeElement is it). 7. Dispatch on the preview a KeyboardEvent("keydown", {key: "o", metaKey: true, bubbles: true}). 8. The preview should still be visible. 9. Press "G". 10. The preview's scrollTop must be greater than 0. 11. Press "g", then "g" again. 12. Its scrollTop must be exactly 0. 13. Press "j". 14. Its scrollTop must be greater than 0. 15. Press "k". 16. Its scrollTop must be exactly 0. 17. Press "d" with the Control modifier. 18. Its scrollTop must be greater than 0. 19. Press "i". 20. The modal's ".monaco-editor" should be visible and the editor input focused (document.activeElement is it).

steps.expression: document.querySelector('[role="dialog"][aria-label*="Edit "] [role="region"][aria-label*="Markdown preview"]').dispatchEvent(new KeyboardEvent('keydown', {key: 'o', metaKey: true, bubbles: true}))
